title: Debate Timer
description: Run debate speeches with configurable segments: live countdown, WebAudio warning bell at 1 minute, end bells, and red overtime tracking.
howto: Add segments with names and minutes (e.g. Opening 5, Rebuttal 3).
Press Start — the current segment counts down live.
A bell rings at 1 minute left and triple bells at time; overtime counts up in red.
Next moves to the following segment; Reset restarts the whole round.

faqs.a: One bell at 60 seconds remaining (warning), three bells at zero (time up). Overtime then counts upward in red so the chair can see exactly how far over the speaker is.

faqs.q: Do I need to enable sound?
faqs.a: The bells use WebAudio, created on your first Start press (browsers require a user gesture). Keep the tab audible and your volume up.
Yes — Start toggles to Pause, freezing the countdown. Reset returns to the first segment with full times.
